key.name: lang
key.description: Either 'en' or 'vi'. Empty follows the system language.

key.name: pet-name
key.description: The name the pet answers to and uses in its speech bubbles.

key.name: daily-target
key.description: How many tasks you should plan for each day (the "Rule of 3").

key.name: work-start
key.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when your working day begins.

key.name: work-end
key.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when your working day ends.

key.name: plan-deadline
key.description: After this hour the pet gets grumpy if today is not planned yet.

key.name: remind-every
key.description: How often the pet nudges you about the next task.

key.name: focus-minutes
key.description: Length of one focus timer session.

key.name: break-minutes
key.description: Length of the break that follows a finished focus session.

key.name: filter-query
key.description: Todoist filter that defines "my day". Empty falls back to 'today | overdue'.

key.name: distraction-apps
key.description: Comma-separated app names that count as distractions.

key.name: sound-mode
key.description: 'off' is silent. 'important' plays sounds for meetings, tasks due now, the end of a focus session and finished tasks; ordinary bubbles stay silent. 'all' plays a sound for every bubble and every grumble.

key.name: work-saturday
key.description: Treat Saturday as a working day.

key.name: work-sunday
key.description: Treat Sunday as a working day.

key.name: pet-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the pet's size on screen.

key.name: chase-when-angry
key.description: When the pet is grumpy it marches toward the mouse pointer.

key.name: watch-browsers
key.description: Read the active browser tab title to notice distracting websites.

key.name: distraction-sites
key.default: 'youtube.com, facebook.com, tiktok.com, instagram.com, x.com, reddit.com, netflix.com'
key.description: Comma-separated sites ("youtube.com") or address parts ("youtube.com/shorts").

key.name: use-calendar
key.description: Read calendar events to warn you before meetings and to plan around them.

key.name: adapt-target
key.description: Lower the daily target on meeting-heavy days.

key.name: meeting-lead
key.description: How many minutes before a meeting the pet warns you.

key.name: stuck-days
key.summary: Days before a task counts as stuck
key.description: After this many days on your list, a task counts as "keeps getting postponed".

key.name: claude-model
key.description: Model used for the optional Claude features. Empty falls back to the default model.

key.name: antics
key.description: Escalating mischief when you slack off (grumbling, sign parade, standing in the way).

key.name: voice-on
key.description: Say some lines out loud with a text-to-speech voice.

key.name: protect-flow
key.description: Hold non-urgent bubbles while you're typing steadily ("in the zone").

key.name: still-while-typing
key.description: Keep the pet still (no walking, small movements) while you type.

key.name: bubble-gap
key.description: Minimum minutes between two unsolicited bubbles.

key.name: keep-log
key.description: Keep the pet's diary (on this computer only, 14 days).

key.name: first-launch
key.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the extension first ran; 0 means not set yet. Used so day one doesn't start with a grumpy pet.

key.name: board-hotkey
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the task board.

key.name: hidden-until
key.description: Unix time in milliseconds until which the pet stays hidden; 0 means the pet is not hidden.

key.name: quiet-until
key.description: Unix time in milliseconds until which the pet stays quiet (no unsolicited bubbles); 0 means not quiet.

key.name: demo-mode
key.description: Developer option. Run with built-in sample tasks and events instead of Todoist and the calendar.

key.name: dev-screenshot-dir
key.description: Developer option. Directory where scene screenshots are saved when dev-scenes is set.

key.name: dev-scenes
key.description: Developer option. Names of scenes the extension plays on start, saving a screenshot of each into dev-screenshot-dir.

key.name: dev-trigger
key.description: Developer option. Writing a command here makes the extension act on it (for example 'parade' or 'golden'); the extension resets it to empty afterwards.

key.name: secrets-serial
key.description: Incremented by the preferences window whenever a stored secret changes, so the extension knows to reload its tokens.
